scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r src/assets src/locales src/notes dist/ && cp src/robots.txt src/sitemap.xml dist/ && npx html-minifier-terser src/index.html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true -o dist/index.html && npx terser dist/assets/js/script.js -o dist/assets/js/script.js && npx terser dist/assets/js/notes.js -o dist/assets/js/notes.js && npx csso-cli dist/assets/css/styles.css -o dist/assets/css/styles.css && npx minify-json dist/locales/en.json && npx minify-json dist/locales/ja.json
